ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Traits & Destinies
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Cultivation traits and destinies for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
Special bodies, Dao hearts, comprehension, spirit crafts, wuxia personalities and souls; very rare destinies (reincarnated, regressor, son of Heaven, antagonist…); and cultivation bonds: Dao partners with dual cultivation, sworn siblings and lifelong rivals.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
